name: Kon'yaku Yubiwa wa Uketorenai
original_name: 婚約指輪は受け取れない
source:
Betrayed and abandoned by your ex-boyfriend, your life begins as a single mother.
As your strength begins to waver and life starts to hit rock bottom...
You meet him.

Which life will you choose?
A fake marriage with a young CEO?
A new start with your ex-boyfriend?
A sweet love with your supervisor?
Do you play out your love with an actor?
translation:
被前男友背叛和抛弃，你的生活开始于单身母亲。
当你的力量开始动摇，生活开始跌入谷底……
你遇见他了。

你会选择哪种生活？
与年轻首席执行官的假婚姻？
和前男友有新的开始吗？
和你的主管有甜蜜的爱情吗？
你会和演员一起演绎爱情吗？
